nodes.text: Veronica, no! Not another shoe store!

nodes.text: Satisfied with her alibi?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And do you know the, um, social pork-levities of a guy like Cameron?

nodes.text: At the local swimming pool...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So Veronica was telling the truth?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah. She couldn't have tampered with the brakes because she was with me... We had a bad break up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are they ever good?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How's she doing? Was she buying some clothes?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Some` might be an understatement.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Some[/i][/color] might be an understatement.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Just like me to break up with the frontrunner for Homecoming Queen a month before the dance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should probably get back, $ALLISON...
She pulls Owen aside.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: One second... If you don't mind, I'd like to socialize for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Weird way to put it, but I guess that's par for the course. I'll be over here by the shallow end.
Owen leaves them alone.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How are `you` doing, Cameron?
nodes.text_bbcode: How are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing, Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm good, all things considered.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If you don't mind, why'd you break up with Veronica?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why do you think?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How would I know?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Come on, the Faceplace incident, our talk about 'candles', and what happened with the float.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're saying...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I broke up with her because of you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Never mind that for now... It seems like you're experiencing some kind of stress cycle brought about by insecurity...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: What? What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You have a severe shopping problem.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: See? Even nerd-bot says so.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: I do `not` have a... Ooh! Look at `those` shoes!
nodes.text_bbcode: I do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] have a... Ooh! Look at [color=#3b78e2][i]those[/i][/color] shoes!

nodes.text: Several impulse purchases later...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe if you talked us through your break up with Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It seems like you're repressing emotions, and then channeling them through shopping.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about... I just know that I `have` to have that coat!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know what you're talking about... I just know that I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to have that coat!

nodes.text: Owen tugs on $ALLISON's sleeve.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Trying to help. She'll tell us what we want to know if she's in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I agree... But I think `you're` the source of her stress!
nodes.text_bbcode: I agree... But I think [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] the source of her stress!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh... I feel like I should have come to that obvious conclusion several purchases ago.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We really don't have time to get deep into the mind of Veronica.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I concur. I'll switch tactics.
$ALLISON pulls Veronica away from a sale.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Get off me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry. I just want to know if you had anything to do with the Harvest Festival incident.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'll get right to the point.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Good. You're already taking up too much of my time.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Did you have anything to do with the incident at the Harvest Festival?
They turn and head out of the shop...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What are you going to do? I think they mean business.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think they do too. But right now, we've got bigger issues to deal with.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Time to pay Veronica a visit?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. I'll drive.

Meanwhile, Paige, Kimi, and Erik get escorted by a servant onto Cromwell's grand estate...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Isn't it romantic that you gave all of this up to be with--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er, never mind.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do `not` remind me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] remind me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'd love living here! There are so many hiding spots!
Cromwell meets them a few moments later near an ornate fountain.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ah, yes. My favorite people from the Double Trouble program.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called Troublemakers!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I know, and yet I do not care. Also, I am mildly saddened to see that you are not in your turkey costume.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Listen, buddy, you already embarrassed Paige enough!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Now it's time to answer some questions! Did you or did you not sabotage our float?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are speaking of the incident... How is your friend?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Spencer's okay. No thanks to you. Well, maybe you. We're not sure if it's you!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Oh, I get it. You are thinking that perhaps it was me who made the float go off course.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I can assure you it was not.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'd like a little more assurance before I leave! After all, you had all kinds of access to the float!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `And` it would make you so happy to embarrass us like that, wouldn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] it would make you so happy to embarrass us like that, wouldn't it?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Not at all. First, I already made my revenge. You got very paint-covered making my float.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Second, I got to boss you around, I got to see you in a ridiculous turkey outfit, and I got to film it and put it all on the internet!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Just look up 'embarrassing videos' online.
Kimi quickly queues it up on her phone. One of the top hits is actually Kimi's music video.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh, for a while there, I'd actually forgotten about that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Aaaah!` Take it off! Take it off!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Allow me to speak from personal experience... You can't take anything off the internet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You girls are `so` famous! It's like I'm in the middle of a celebrity couple!
nodes.text_bbcode: You girls are [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] famous! It's like I'm in the middle of a celebrity couple!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Anyway, I required no further satisfaction...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Also, the float accident hurt me financially since the Harvest Festival was ruined.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You know how I feel about money. Why would I do something to make less of it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's got a point.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Let's just get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: If you ever put the bird suit on again, just let me know. My camera is waiting!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Blech. Let's get out of here `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Blech. Let's get out of here [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I'm convinced it wasn't him...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then let's go talk to Brinna...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good call, $ALLISON. How'd you know they'd be here?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I am marginally aware of the social proclivities of the modern American teenage girl.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, sorry. I mean, I had a hunch.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Let me have that credit card! I just need to buy one more pair of shoes!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: It's my `mom's!` And you already bought, like, every shoe in the mall!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh, hello, Veronica. Candace.

nodes.text: You! If you've come to gloat about my break up with Cameron, this isn't over!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You broke up?!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Like you didn't know! You might have forced Cameron to--
Veronica's attention turns to a sign in a display window.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: --Never mind! That top is on sale! I have to have it!
She marches into a nearby store and comes out almost an instant later, holding a cute designer blouse.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: How did you buy that with all your credit cards maxed out?!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: I have my ways.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: And my debts...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Shh.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry. Couldn't help it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, Sal. Keying my truck was one thing, but what you did to our float was over the line! My friend is in the hospital!
Owen's fists clench tight!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Wait, wait, wait. What are you talking about? What's a float?

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: It's a truck with stuff on it.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I didn't ask you! But since you're talking...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: You do anything to this float?!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: No! I just keyed his truck!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Dominic, I'm gonna ask you one more time... You do anything to this float?!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: No! I swear!
Sal turns back to $ALLISON and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: We didn't do anything to your float. Dom might be dumb, but he's not dumb enough to lie to me. You have my word.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I wish your word meant something to me.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: My word should mean a lot to you. But since according to you it doesn't, I'll jog your memory.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: `I` spent two years in juvie because of what `we` did. I gave you my word that I wouldn't rat... And I never did.

nodes.text: He releases his hold on Owen's neck...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: And when I say we didn't do nothing to any float, we didn't do nothing.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anything. We didn't do `anything.`

nodes.text: Owen shoots her a sideways glance.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: We're trying to persuade you to help us out, Owen. You offer up a set of skills no one else has. The best getaway driver there is. Period.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Anyway, we'd admit if we did anything, same as we did with keying your truck. It's in our interest for you to know that we're upset with you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that's convincing enough... Even if it is unsettling.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's go, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Play time is over. The gloves are coming off. You don't help us, and this gets real. Fast.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So much for friends, eh?

nodes.text: And in case I'm being too subtle... Dom told me about that grandma of yours.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Oh yeah? She's cute, man. I like that you brought her here.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Shows a certain amount of trust. Considering how strained things are between us.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What can I say? I'd like to think you and I were friends once. No reason we can't be friends again.
Owen reaches over and gives $ALLISON's hand a squeeze.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think that went rather well!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Heh. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Check it out, everybody. Owen's got himself some first-rate protection. She's wearing a sweater too, in case it gets cold.
Owen whispers to $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So much for the upper hand.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Since we don't have much time, the rest of you should investigate some of our other suspects.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We'll go talk to Cromwell first.

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.text: Maybe he'll give us more tasks! It'll be like we're all unpaid interns again!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Then I will do just that! I will knock them dead!
Twenty minutes later, $ALLISON and Owen step into an auto body shop in a bad part of town...
Dom is wiping his greasy hands off on a towel that's already blackened, while Big Jon's legs are sticking out from underneath a sports coupe.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suddenly feel overdressed.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me too, and I'm wearing jeans and a t-shirt.
Dom sees them and kicks Big Jon's foot. Big Jon slides out from under the car, his face splotched with grease.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Lookie, lookie, lookie. If it isn't our old friend Owen and... You must be his protection?

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Heh. She's so small.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Ha! Yeah, why'd you bring a fairy princess to this fight, Owen? You're here to fight, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm `not` here to fight. Yet. And she's here because I thought I might need extra protection.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] here to fight. Yet. And she's here because I thought I might need extra protection.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Heh. She can't protect you from me. She's too little.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Try me, oaf.
Big Jon's smile disappears, and Dom doubles over with laughter... Suddenly a voice booms out from the back.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: What's going on out here?!
Owen curses under his breath. The rest of the auto shop goes quiet, and Dom and Big Jon scurry back to work.
As the guy lumbers toward them, Owen whispers to $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's Sal. He's trouble.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I thought the last guys were trouble.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, but this guy's capital 'T' Trouble. We can't let him get the upper hand.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Got it.
Sal stops, his face serious for a moment. Owen gulps. Then...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Owen! What's up, friend?!
He embraces Owen in a tremendous bear hug!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Can you believe I'm out?! It's been too long!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Who's this? Don't tell me you've finally got a girl?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... This is $ALLISON. She's just my... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...I'm his...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Me? You think `I` should go with Owen on his super scary mission?
nodes.text_bbcode: Me? You think [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] should go with Owen on his super scary mission?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe not...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Cause I'll totally go it's just that I'm not really tough or intimidating or scary...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And it seems like everyone participating will be all those things, so I--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't have to go.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, thank you so much!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, if you're all insisting somebody come with me, then I think it should be $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. You're in that sweet spot of not annoying me and being capable of defending yourself in a fight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll get started on the Venn diagram!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huh-ho! I never get picked for anything!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nuh-uh. That's not going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why not? Erik is very capable.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, at picking up trash and singing nonsense. This is a `lot` different.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, at picking up trash and singing nonsense. This is a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] different.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I agree. Whenever I try to hang with hooligans, I end up in a trash receptacle!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, if you're all insisting somebody come with me, then I think it should be $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. You're in that sweet spot of not annoying me and being capable of defending yourself in a fight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll get started on the Venn diagram!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: He's a tough, intimidating guy! I'll bet he'll have them shaking in their shoes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you okay? Have you completely forgotten that we're in Spencer's `hospital` room?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you okay? Have you completely forgotten that we're in Spencer's [color=#e23b3b][i]hospital[/i][/color] room?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, you okay, Red?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, uh... I don't know what I was thinking... It can't be Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, if you're all insisting somebody come with me, then I think it should be $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. You're in that sweet spot of not annoying me and being capable of defending yourself in a fight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll get started on the Venn diagram!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of the rest of us, I'll be able to handle myself best.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Sweater Suzie can go. She knows tae kwan jujitsu or whatever it is.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Judo, you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... How do we get started?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's easy enough. I think we start by coming up with a list of suspects from the Harvest Festival.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You mean like Dom?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: He was there?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. Him and his thug Big Jon threatened me again.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyone else?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I nominate Brinna. She was talking about how she was going to make the best float...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Plus she's super crazy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd say Nate should be a suspect, but I didn't see him there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, he came looking for you. I don't think he sabotaged the float though.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He knew you left. Why would he sabotage the float if he wasn't sure you'd be on it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: See? We're already making progress!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cromwell's on my list. I mean, he definitely had it in for me all day.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I have a hazy memory from right before the float hit me... Of you inside the mouth of a surprised turkey?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's move on. Now.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd like to add Veronica. She saw me with Cameron and posted a picture of us together on Faceplace to try and smear my rep.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ouch. I'm sorry, $ALLISON. I know how it feels to get attacked online.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: She finds me very displeasing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, that's four suspects. Dom, Brinna, Cromwell, and Veronica.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, and I saw Jeremy there! He was acting really strange right before the incident.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, were you having more trouble with Jeremy?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope! I mean, he's still a little peeved about the whole 'stealing his girl' thing, but I think we're on the short road to being BFFs!
The rest of the Troublemakers share glances with each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, so we'll `definitely` come back to that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so we'll [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] come back to that...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Who should we investigate first?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know who `I'm` talking to. Not only did Dom threaten me, but my truck got keyed.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know who [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] talking to. Not only did Dom threaten me, but my truck got keyed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Why didn't you say something sooner?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It didn't seem important what with Spencer nearly dying and us possibly getting expelled!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So? It could mean you're in danger!
Owen looks at Paige with a wide-eyed expression...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And, uh, what do you care about me being in danger?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I, uh, er, don't care! Not at all! So, never mind!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway... My old crew knows a lot about cars too, so it wouldn't have been hard for them to tamper with the float's brakes or the steering.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll find them and get back to you as soon as it's over!
Owen starts to leave when the rest of the group shouts for him to stop.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's no way I'm, er, `we're` letting you go talk to those guys alone!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no way I'm, er, [color=#3b78e2][i]we're[/i][/color] letting you go talk to those guys alone!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's right.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll go with you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think that's a good idea. You two haven't exactly been playing nice with each other. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. I guess... That has to be true.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You should go with...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. You sound like an after school special.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Excuse me for being the only one who thinks that in our final hours together we should spend it in good company!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guys! We can't get down about this!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've seen it a hundred times... A team is beaten down to nothing, and then in the final minutes...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They just suplex their opponents and pin them for the count!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is this a football game or a wrestling match?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not sure, but it sounds awesome!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And the point is that we shouldn't give up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Guys, Spencer's right. No offense, $ALLISON, but I don't want to give up just yet!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me neither.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I just thought you had all given up already. That's all.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We did. Until Spencer rallied us.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I comprehend now...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Personally, I'm on the side of being active. At least this way I can say I tried. Who's with me?
$ALLISON puts her hand in the middle of them all, above Spencer's broken leg. Owen puts his hand on top of hers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When you put it like that... I'm in.
Erik throws his hand on top.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can never resist a power-chanting circle!
Kimi follows suit.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We'll actually be like `real` detectives! So cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll actually be like [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] detectives! So cool!

nodes.text: Spencer struggles to raise himself up in bed, mustering the strength to put his hand in on top of the others.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If any of you says you're doing this for me, I'll punch you.
The group turns, looking at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? I'm in! I'm just not doing this lame hand thing.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Troublemakers on three! One! Two! Three!
All the Troublemakers except Paige cheer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And... What?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And, uh, and spend some time together?
$ALLISON manages to avoid stepping on all the trash and pumpkin leftovers!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Surprisingly easy!
When she reaches the cornfield...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahhhhhh!
Paige cries out from behind as she slips on a stringy clump of pumpkin guts, landing hard on her butt!
$ALLISON starts to head back when Owen arrives to help Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got her. Don't worry about us. Just go get him!
$ALLISON nods, zipping through the cornfield, Kimi sprinting in the cornrow alongside her!
...She has failed.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: But I had to pick up a big shipment of flowers that morning! They were all for her!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then... She lied?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Big time.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's go talk to the liar, then!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Boy howdy! I feel like I'm about to get into a dance battle!
You are now playing as Kimi.
At the retirement center...
The Troublemakers step into the theater room...
$ALLISON whispers to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Where is Officer Monte?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He'll be here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course he will. He's an officer of the law!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, he'd better! I used some of my minutes calling him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on. Let's go make our presence known.
The Troublemakers walk over to Brinna. Her face hardens when she sees them!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: What are you doing back here?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You sabotaged our float! You saw how good ours was, and you couldn't handle it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was you who cut the brakes and the steering!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: And do you have proof for such a ridiculous claim?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The police are taking this very seriously. We've got fingerprints.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Sure you do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You might want to confess now to get a lesser sentence.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The cops aren't going to be nearly as nice as us.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Uh huh. I guess this is the place for great performances... But I'm not buying it. Not even a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's true!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Very` true.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Very[/i][/color] true.

nodes.text: Kimi glances at the door to the theater...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: If you'll excuse me, I have legitimate issues to deal with.
Just then, Officer Monte flings open the door! A menacing scowl on his face!
Brinna's eyes widen! Her facade falls!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Okay! Okay! I did it! I was the one who sabotaged the float at the Harvest Festival!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: But I just wanted to ruin the float! I didn't know that $ALLISON would be there... Or that Spencer would get hurt!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: ...I feel awful.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What?! What in the world are you yapping about?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Wait... You don't have fingerprints?! You're... Not here to arrest me?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No! These hooligans said there was a part for me in a theater production...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And you played it perfectly.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh! Uh... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: You tricked me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You said this was a place for a great performance...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've heard enough! Come with me, young lady!
Monte escorts a stammering Brinna out of the retirement center...
You are now playing as Ms. Lee.
That night, Ms. Lee meets in the home office of the school district superintendent...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: It's late, Dolores. This had better be good.
He gestures for her to sit, and she does as he stares coldly out the window into his backyard.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's better than good! The students involved in the Harvest Festival incident have proven themselves innocent!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: I see... They just... Took matters into their own hands like that?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: They did. Like tiny vigilantes!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Not a label I'd be proud of...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes, sir...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So what happens now?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Now all the obvious pieces will fall into place, exactly as you'd expect.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: We'll get to that in a moment... Frankly, I'm more concerned about the future of your school!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Do you really `know` what your students are up to all the time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] what your students are up to all the time?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I have a vague sense...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Vague?! `Vague?!` Vague is not a word I `ever` want to hear from one of the administrators under `my` watch!
nodes.text_bbcode: Vague?! [color=#e23b3b][i]Vague?![/i][/color] Vague is not a word I [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] want to hear from one of the administrators under [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] watch!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: I watch `you` vigilantly, and in turn you watch `them` vigilantly!
nodes.text_bbcode: I watch [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] vigilantly, and in turn you watch [color=#e23b3b][i]them[/i][/color] vigilantly!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: If you can't get on board, I don't want you around!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Is that clear? Or am I being too 'vague'?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's clear. I didn't realize there was a problem, since our school is considered the best in the district.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: `By the students!` But what do `they` know?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]By the students![/i][/color] But what do [color=#e23b3b][i]they[/i][/color] know?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I assure you, Carlos, they know more than--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: --As long as the matter is business, you'll address me as sir or superintendent!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Then I expect you to address me as ma'am or Ms. Lee.
The superintendent glares at her.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I was saying, `sir,` that I assure you our school is operating smoothly.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was saying, [color=#3b78e2][i]sir,[/i][/color] that I assure you our school is operating smoothly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: It obviously isn't if your students are acting as vigilantes, doing police work instead of homework!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anyway... I'll pass on the good news to the students. Is there anything more to discuss?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Brushing off your superior, are you, Dolores?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Sir?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Rivera
nodes.text: Never mind. Just know that changes are coming. I hope your students have the stomachs for them.
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
The next day...
The Troublemakers, including a crutches-wielding Spencer, crowd around Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Congratulations, all of you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now that Brinna's confessed to the crime, you're no longer to be expelled from school.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm so `so` proud of all of you! Especially you, Spencer! Great detective work!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] proud of all of you! Especially you, Spencer! Great detective work!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He spent the whole time in the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Is that any way to talk to a one-legged man?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He `has` both legs!
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] both legs!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Shameful!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, does this mean the Troublemakers program is back on?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unfortunately, no. The superintendent has decided to cancel this rather experimental program.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So our sentences are served?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Nice try. As a lighter punishment for all of your transgressions, you are to serve detention after school for the rest of the year.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where do we do that?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Excellent question! Come with me...
A few minutes later, Ms. Lee unlocks the door to a small lounge.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You are required by the district to spend time in this room for one hour after school.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: During that time, you are to work on your studies, refrain from talking, and remain in the room until the hour has expired.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That sounds awful!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes, it does. And I want all of you to note that these rules are to be enforced by me. And that I'll be all the way on the other side of campus.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Which is very far away. Where I can't really monitor you. Are you getting this?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm saying I won't be monitoring you very closely.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We got it, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Super cool, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anything for you, dear.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And the rest of you too, I guess.
Ms. Lee leaves, giving the Troublemakers a chance to survey their new lounge...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I really like the ambience...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There's a refrigerator here!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's got its own bathroom! With a mirror!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can see outside through the window!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Meh. It's a room.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guys, this place is awesome! We should totally have a party here! And not just any party...
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A Halloween party!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good call on the festivities, my good chap! In all that hullabaloo, we forgot one of our most sacred traditions!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not cool, dude. You sound like $ALLISON when you're wearing that thing.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that so bad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. I can only handle so many S.E.T. vocab words at a time.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I think it's `purrr`fect.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I think it's [color=#3b78e2][i]purrr[/i][/color]fect.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Lady and gent, with that cringeworthy pun, I must away.
Owen slips off. Spencer turns to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did I tell you that you look cute as a cat?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh... Well, you do.
$ALLISON blushes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks. I... I like your costume too. Very debonair.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just threw it together last minute.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, it looks good on you. You look... Handsome actually.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What I meant to say was... You look handsome.
On a makeshift dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Look at me go! I do a little dance! I shake my nerdy butt! {

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Erik, you're actually kind of a good dancer!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So what are you supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Originally, a witch. But then it kind of became an older-looking outfit, so I'm thinking now I'm like an accused witch during the Salem Witch trials.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am a fan of historical costumes!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That, and I like the color purple.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's that dance move you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, you mean... The Kimi Shimmy?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heh. Teach me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why am I watching this?
